title: Unsupervised Multi-Scale Gromov-Wasserstein Hypergraph Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.29635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study unsupervised hypergraph alignment, where the goal is to infer node correspondences between two hypergraphs using only structural information, without node features, labels, seed matches, or side information. Direct higher-order formulations can represent hyperedge interactions faithfully, but they can be computationally demanding and cumbersome for non-uniform hypergraphs. Graph-reduction approaches introduce a different challenge: clique expansions keep the alignment problem on the original node set but collapse all hyperedge evidence into one pairwise graph, whereas bipartite expansions preserve incidence structure but enlarge the problem from nodes to nodes plus hyperedges. We introduce FALCON (Filtration-based hypergrAph aLignment via Cross-scale Optimal traNsport), an unsupervised optimal-transport framework for hypergraph alignment. translated_title: 无监督多尺度Gromov-Wasserstein超图对齐
translated_abstract: 我们研究无监督超图对齐问题，其目标是仅利用结构信息来推断两个超图之间的节点对应关系，而无需节点特征、标签、种子匹配或任何辅助信息。直接的高阶形式化方法能够忠实地表示超边交互，但对于非均匀超图而言计算开销大且处理繁琐。图约简方法则带来了另一类挑战：团扩展将对齐问题保持在原始节点集上，但会把所有超边证据压缩进单一的成对图中；而二部图扩展虽然保留了关联结构，却将问题规模从节点扩大到节点加超边。我们提出FALCON（基于过滤的超图对齐跨尺度最优传输方法），这是一个用于超图对齐的无监督最优传输框架。FALCON不再用单一的压缩团图来表示每个超图，而是构建（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出FALCON框架，一种基于过滤和跨尺度最优传输的无监督超图对齐方法，仅利用结构信息即可推断两个超图间的节点对应关系，同时避免了直接高阶方法的高计算开销与图约简方法的结构信息损失。
en_tdlr: FALCON is an unsupervised optimal-transport framework for hypergraph alignment that leverages filtration-based multi-scale representations and cross-scale Gromov-Wasserstein transport to infer node correspondences using only structural information, avoiding the computational burden of direct higher-order formulations and the information loss of graph-reduction approaches.
